2. Craft 3 bone meal using 1 bone.
3. Now that we have bone meal, we can craft 1 white dye using 1 bone meal.
4. We don't need to craft another bone meal since we already have one to make the white dye.

So, the exact ordered sequence of steps needed is:

1. Gather 1 bone.
2. Craft 3 bone meal using the 1 bone.
3. Use 1 bone meal to craft 1 white dye.

This will produce exactly the white dye we need.
